title: The Casita at The Lemon Drop | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
h1: The Casita at The Lemon Drop
meta_description: The Casita at The Lemon Drop is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 1BR/1BA Seacrest Retreat – Pet Friendly & PrivateThe Casita at The Lemon Drop is your private hideaway in Seacrest, ideal for couples, solo travelers, or smaller groups. Cozy, comfortable, and fully independent, it lets you enjoy all the perks of the Lemon Drop property while having your own space.Your SpaceThe Casita accommodates up to 4 guests with 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom. The living area has a sofa that pulls out to a queen bed, and the kitchen is equipped with a Keurig, microwave, and refrigerator, plus an eat-in counter with 3 bar stools, perfect for casual meals or morning coffee. The Casita also has its own washer and dryer for convenience during longer stays. Enjoy the shared picnic area and gas grill in the backyard.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom: Queen bed, TV with Jack and Jill bathroomLiving Area: Sofa that pulls out to a queen-size bedBeach AccessEnjoy private beach access just an 8-minute walk or shuttle hop on the seasonal tram, making beach days easy and hassle-free. The tram provides convenient service to the soft white sands and clear Gulf waters of Seacrest Beach.Seacrest BeachDuring your stay, you can take advantage of the Seacrest community’s amenities, including one of the largest lagoon pools on 30A, ideal for swimming and lounging. Explore Peddler’s Pavilion with local shops, restaurants, bike rentals, and open-air events, or enjoy the neighborhood trails and bike paths for walking, running, or cycling. Community picnic areas and open green spaces provide additional spots to relax outdoors.Location & Local ExperiencesStaying at Lemon Drop House places you close to the activities that make the 30A area special. Start mornings with bike rides along nearby paths, spend afternoons at the beach, and plan evenings around local food and entertainment:* Shades Bar & Grill – casual meals and live music* George’s at Alys Beach – coastal cuisine* Rosemary Beach downtown – including The Pearl, Sugar Shack, boutique shops, and outdoor events* 30Avenue – Amigos, Amici’s, Idyll Proper, and Attycat’s Arcade* The Big Chill – beachfront bar and restaurant with a relaxed vibe, perfect for drinks or casual dining* Watersound Town Center – Publix, Village Market, Ambrosia, Nigel’s, and Sweet Henrietta’sEverything from grocery runs to family-friendly outings is within easy reach.Your stay at The Casita at The Lemon Drop comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Other Details to Note:* Snowbird Friendly!* Parking for I car only.* Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach community.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 40 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
